evidence.reason: The current code still captures `pre = preflight(...)` before the stopped-unit and drain checks, then passes that same `pre["state"]` to `preservation_check` after the helper switch. A tick that publishes queue/heartbeat updates after preflight but before the stopped/drain checks can therefore make the post-switch preservation comparison fail even though the helper did not write those files. Moving the preservation baseline capture to after the successful drain is a routine correctness fix and does not require owner judgment.
